title: Cloud Engineering Specialist
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

As a Cloud Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, deploy, and maintain cloud-based solutions primarily on the Microsoft Azure platform. The ideal candidate will also have a solid understanding of ETL processes and technologies, as well as experience with a variety of data sources. You will work closely with our clients, development teams, infrastructure teams, data & analytics team, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation and operation of cloud services. Your role will involve designing and implementing scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures, as well as troubleshooting and resolving any issues that arise.

Additionally, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution.

**Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to**:

* The shift timings for this role is 5:00PM - 2:00AM IST (7:30AM - 4:30PM ET)
* Identify & map source data in various commercial and custom systems
* Design, develop, test and maintain ETL pipelines
* Extract, transform, and load data from a variety of data sources
* Work with data engineers and other stakeholders to define data requirements
* Troubleshoot and debug ETL pipelines
* Stay up-to-date on ETL technologies and best practices
* Formulate development estimates (task, effort, dependencies, etc.)
* Develop test cases and demonstrate results for assigned deliverables.
* Maintain and present daily/weekly status
* Articulate project deliverable details and activities to client and project team members
* Adapt to various industries and quickly learn the client’s context, language, and jargon to clearly document and translate business requirements to development plans
* Maintain a professional presence and be ready to interact with the client at all times
* Azure Solution Design: Collaborate with development teams and architects to design cloud-based solutions on the Azure platform. Evaluate requirements, propose design options, and recommend best practices for scalability, performance, security, and cost optimization.
* Azure Networking: Designing, implementing, and maintaining network infrastructure solutions based on Azure services i.e Configuring and managing virtual networks, subnets, routing tables, network security groups, and load balancers within the Azure environment, Configuring the IP-Sec VPN tunnels and troubleshooting network-related issues and providing timely resolution to minimize downtime.
* Azure Infrastructure Deployment: Deploy and configure Azure infrastructure components, such as virtual machines, storage accounts, virtual networks, load balancers and other azure services. Implement automation and infrastructure-as-code (IaaC) practices using tools like Terraform, Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, PowerShell, or Azure CLI.
* Azure Service Provisioning: Provision and manage Azure services, including but not limited to Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure SQL Database, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Active Directory (AAD).
* Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Set up monitoring and alerting mechanisms to ensure the health and performance of Azure resources. Investigate and resolve issues related to application availability, performance, and security. Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
* Security and Compliance: Implement and enforce security measures to protect Azure resources and data. Follow industry best practices and compliance standards. Conduct security assessments and vulnerability scans and implement necessary remediation actions.
* Backup and Disaster Recovery: Design and implement backup and disaster recovery strategies for Azure-based applications and data. Configure and manage Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, and other relevant services.
* Collaboration and Documentation: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and support project delivery. Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, and deployment guides.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest Azure features, services, and industry trends. Continuously explore and propose new solutions, tools, and methodologies to optimize cloud infrastructure, enhance security, and streamline operations.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Strong experience in designing, implementing, and managing cloud solutions on the Azure platform (AWS and GCP is a plus)
* Previous consulting experience or experience working with external clients
* Strong understanding of ETL processes and technologies
* Experience with a variety of data sources, including relational databases, flat files, and web APIs
* Experience with Python, Java, or another programming language
* Experience with data warehouse technologies, such as Azure, AWS, and Snowflake
* Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
* Strong communication and teamwork skills
* Solid understanding of software development life cycle models as well as expert knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit a project and business environment
* Technical background, with understanding or hands-on experience in enterprise solutions for different industries
* High-level knowledge of BI architecture or data warehousing
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Effectively managing multiple deliverables, clients and projects in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency in Azure services, including compute, storage, networking, and identity and access management (IAM).
* Proven experience in designing and implementing network infrastructure solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Strong knowledge of Azure networking services, including virtual networks, VPN gateways, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, and Azure Load Balancer.
* Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards related to cloud environments.
* Solid understanding of cloud architecture patterns, scalability, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaaC) tools like ARM templates, PowerShell, or Azure CLI.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in Azure cloud environments ((AWS and GCP is a plus).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with teams and stakeholders.

**Key Stakeholders This Role Interacts With:**

**Internal**

* Senior BI Analyst
* Data Product Manager
* BI Architect / Senior Architect
* Data Engineers
* Analytics Developers (Power BI, Tableau)

**External**

* Clients Operations Leads and Mid-Level Managers
* Data Owners, Data Stewards
* Enterprise Information Management and Data Governance Team
* IT Staff – Architects, DBAs, Developers, etc

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. title: Structural Engineer
description:
**Thornton Tomasetti** applies engineering and scientific principles to solve the world’s challenges. An independent organization of creative thinkers and innovative doers collaborating from offices worldwide, our mission is to bring our clients' ideas to life and, in the process, lay the groundwork for a better, more resilient future. We provide support and opportunities to our employees to achieve their full potential and cultivate a rewarding career.

Our **Structural Engineering** practice collaborates with architects, building owners, and builders to design elegant solutions for projects of all types, sizes, and levels of complexity. From designing the world’s tallest buildings and most extended spans to engineering inventive “jewel-box” structures and designing major expansion projects, we continually seek the best balance among the demands of form, function, sustainability, constructability, schedule, and budget.

  

**Your Role**

As an Engineer in our Structural Practice, you will perform structural analysis, design and detailing for all types of buildings, using a variety of materials and building codes. You will contribute to a variety of small to mid-sized projects, including high-rise, cultural buildings, stadiums, healthcare, and more while learning the foundational skills needed to deliver high-quality design. With support from your team, you will work on projects in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment, ideal for engineers eager to grow their technical and creative skills.

**What You’ll Do**

  

* Tackle real structural analysis and design challenges across a variety of building types while applying core engineering principles to create impactful, high-quality solutions.
* Create construction documents in a BIM environment, sharpening your technical skills through collaborative hands-on work.
* Work side-by-side with seasoned engineers who will coach, guide, and support your growth from day one.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with teammates and project partners as you learn to navigate real-world project environments.
* Build your early-career network and get to know Thornton Tomasetti’s culture, values, and services while practicing leadership behaviors like authenticity, trust-building, and effective communication.

**What You’ll Bring**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Architectural Engineering; Master’s degree in structural engineering is preferred.
* Familiarity with tools like SAP2000, ETABS, RAM, StructurePoint Software, and Revit are a plus.
* Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a genuine eagerness to learn, ask questions, and grow through feedback.
* A detail-oriented approach with the ability to apply fundamental engineering concepts and check your work with care and curiosity.

description:
**Machine Builder Architect | Building the Future of Deeptech Manufacturing**

**Build the machine. Architect the system. Bring the technology to life.**

**What if your next engineering project was not another machine to maintain, but an entirely new machine to create?**

We are looking for an engineer who thinks beyond individual components and sees the complete machine.

Someone who can take a manufacturing challenge, break it into functional modules, determine how each module should work, select the right technologies, bring together the necessary engineering capabilities and turn the design into a working system.

**If you enjoy building machines more than merely operating them, this is an opportunity to make your mark.**

**The Mission**

You will help architect and build a modular, automated manufacturing system from the ground up.

The platform brings together precision material handling, sensors, electronics, motion control, robotics, electrochemical process equipment, machine vision and industrial automation. Each module will be designed to operate independently, tested against defined requirements and integrated into a coordinated manufacturing system.

You will own the instrumentation, electronics and control architecture that connects these elements into one functioning machine.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will move between system architecture, component selection, circuit and control design, vendor coordination, physical integration, troubleshooting and commissioning.

You will work directly with the founder and a multidisciplinary engineering team, with meaningful influence over the design decisions that shape the manufacturing platform.

**The Engineer We Want to Meet**

You may call yourself an Instrumentation Engineer, Electronics Engineer, Controls Engineer, Mechatronics Engineer or Automation Engineer. Your title matters less than what you have actually built.

You are likely to thrive here if:

* You naturally think in systems, interfaces, feedback loops and failure modes.
* You can translate an engineering requirement into a practical machine architecture.
* You understand how sensors, electronics, actuators, controllers and mechanical systems work together.
* You enjoy solving problems that cross traditional engineering boundaries.
* You can work with fabricators, suppliers and specialists to get a machine built, not just documented.
* You are comfortable moving from a schematic or control sequence to the shop floor to diagnose why something is not working.
* You value sound engineering judgement, reliable execution and well-documented results.

You do not need to be the world's leading expert in every discipline. You do need the technical depth to make informed decisions, the curiosity to learn unfamiliar systems and the ability to bring the right people and technologies together.

**What You Should Bring**

* A degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical and Electronics, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering or a related discipline.
* Typically five or more years of relevant experience in custom machine building, industrial automation, instrumentation, controls or equipment integration.
* Demonstrable experience taking machinery or an automation system from requirements through design, integration and commissioning.
* Practical knowledge of sensors, actuators, electrical schematics, control hardware and industrial communication.
* Experience with PLCs, embedded controllers, HMI, motion control or industrial data acquisition.

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy working across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

As GCRS continues to expand across international markets and strengthen its technology, digital products and operational capabilities, we are seeking a **Business Architect** to help shape the way the organization operates and grows.

This position sits at the intersection of business strategy, operations and technology. The successful candidate will examine how different functions work together, identify opportunities for improvement and help create practical structures that support the company's long\-term objectives.

This role offers an opportunity to work on genuine business challenges, influence decision\-making and contribute to the development of processes and systems that can support GCRS as it scales.

**The Role**

The Business Architect will work with management and teams across regulatory, commercial, operations, technology and product functions to understand business priorities and translate them into workable solutions.

You will examine existing processes, systems and operating models, challenge areas that are no longer effective and help design better ways of working.

Some projects may involve technology implementation or digital transformation, while others may focus on organisational structure, workflow design, process improvement or business planning. The ability to understand the wider business context while paying attention to operational details will be important.

This is a practical role for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems and can move confidently between strategic conversations and detailed process discussions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review existing business processes and workflows to understand what is working well and where teams may be facing unnecessary delays, duplication or inefficiencies.
* Work with stakeholders to understand business objectives and turn those objectives into clear, realistic and actionable requirements.
* Help develop business architecture frameworks and operating models that support the company's current needs while allowing room for future growth.
* Look for practical ways to improve productivity, reduce manual work and make business processes easier to manage and scale.
* Map key business functions, processes, capabilities and information flows to create a clear picture of how different areas of the organisation connect.
* Work with management to convert broader business strategies into structured initiatives, priorities and implementation plans.
* Identify gaps between the way a process works today and what the business will need in the future as GCRS expands.
* Prepare clear business requirements for software, digital transformation and technology\-related projects.
* Work closely with software developers, AI engineers, data specialists and product teams to ensure that technology solutions address genuine business requirements.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of digital products and technology\-enabled services offered by GCRS.
* Assess existing processes and systems and recommend where technology could make operations more efficient or improve the client experience.
* Explore opportunities to introduce automation and AI where they can deliver meaningful improvements rather than adding unnecessary complexity.
* Create process maps, workflows, business models and functional requirements that can be easily understood by both business and technical teams.
* Understand how changes to one business function or system may affect other departments, processes, data or client\-facing activities.
* Support teams in designing and introducing new processes that are practical, clearly documented and easy for employees to adopt.
* Help GCRS build scalable operating structures that can support increasing clients, services, markets and internal teams.
* Review business performance and operational information to identify areas where processes, resources or systems could be improved.
* Prepare business cases, recommendations and supporting analysis for new projects, systems and strategic initiatives.
* Help management assess and prioritise business and technology projects based on their potential value, urgency, complexity and business impact.
* Bring relevant stakeholders together to clarify project objectives, define scope and ensure that expectations are aligned before implementation begins.
* Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams, helping both sides understand requirements, limitations and expected outcomes.
* Identify operational risks, process gaps and areas where the current way of working may create challenges as the business grows.
* Support the implementation of new processes and help teams adapt to changes in systems, technology and ways of working.
* Maintain clear documentation covering business processes, requirements, workflows, operating models and key business decisions.
* Review the results of implemented solutions and recommend further improvements where the expected business outcomes have not been fully achieved.
* Keep up to date with developments in AI, automation, digital transformation and modern business architecture practices that could be relevant to GCRS.

**What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate will have a strong interest in understanding how businesses function and how they can operate more effectively.

The candidate should be comfortable asking challenging questions, examining information from different sources and developing a clear view of a problem before recommending a solution.

The position requires someone who can understand the priorities of senior management while remaining close enough to day\-to\-day operations to recognise practical issues that may otherwise be overlooked.

Commercial awareness, sound judgement and the ability to communicate clearly will matter as much as technical knowledge.

We are looking for a person who can connect **business strategy, operational requirements and technology** without losing sight of the people who ultimately use the processes and systems.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* A degree or professional background in business architecture, business analysis, consulting, strategy, operations, information systems or a related discipline.
* Strong knowledge of business processes, organisational structures and operating models, with the ability to assess how they function in practice.
* Proven capability in gathering requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, meetings and process reviews.
* A structured approach to analysing complex problems and breaking them into manageable areas for action.
* Confidence in documenting business processes and explaining them clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Practical knowledge of workflow design, process mapping and requirements documentation.
* An understanding of how technology systems support business activities and how changes in one area can affect others.
* The ability to collaborate effectively with people from different departments, levels of seniority and professional backgrounds.
* Skill in converting business needs into clear functional requirements that development or implementation teams can act upon.
* Familiarity with digital transformation concepts and the role technology can play in changing established business models.
* Working knowledge of project delivery and organisational change, particularly where new systems or processes are being introduced.
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to recognise inefficiencies and propose realistic improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong organisational skills for managing multiple initiatives, stakeholder discussions and competing priorities.
* Commercial understanding of how operational decisions affect cost, efficiency, customer experience and business growth.

**Desirable Experience**

* Exposure to management consulting, strategic advisory or business transformation projects can provide useful experience for this position.
* Familiarity with AI and automation initiatives will help when assessing opportunities to modernise existing workflows.
* Knowledge of business process management platforms can assist with analysing and redesigning complex operational activities.
* Experience with CRM, ERP or other enterprise business systems.
* Participation in digital transformation programmes and knowledge of enterprise architecture.
* Familiarity with BPMN or another recognised process\-modelling methodology
* Experience preparing transformation roadmaps or investment proposals.
* Exposure to data, reporting and analytics projects.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within the first six months, you will have:

* Developed a clear understanding of GCRS's major functions, services, workflows and operating structure.
* Produced meaningful process documentation for selected areas of the business where greater clarity or consistency is required.
* Presented management with a prioritised view of operational improvement opportunities.
* Identified specific activities where automation or AI could deliver measurable business value.
* Supported the requirements and planning stages of selected technology initiatives.
* Established productive working relationships between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Contributed to the design of processes that can accommodate future growth without creating unnecessary operational complexity.
* Provided practical recommendations based on stakeholder feedback, process analysis and available business information.
* Assisted with at least one significant business transformation or technology\-enabled improvement initiative.
* Introduced a more structured approach to capturing business requirements, process changes and solution decisions.
* Demonstrated measurable improvements in selected areas of efficiency, workflow clarity or cross\-functional coordination.

**Why Join Us?**

GCRS is entering an exciting phase of growth, with increasing international activity alongside investment in technology, AI and digital capabilities.

The Business Architect will have the opportunity to work across multiple areas of the organisation rather than being restricted to a single department or system.

The candidate will gain direct exposure to management and collaborate with regulatory, commercial, operations, technology and product teams. The role is particularly suited to someone who wants to build something rather than simply maintain an existing structure. As the company's technology and operating capabilities develop, there will be scope to take on greater responsibility across business transformation, strategy and technology.
